Not every dog can do this, and not every trainer can or should. With the owners' permission, I used Bishop to help communicate a lesson to Ryder. Dogs naturally understand other dogs better than they understand us. The goal wasn't to make Ryder love every dog she sees-it was to teach her that she doesn't need to react to every dog she sees. Before training, a simple neighborhood walk was nearly impossible. Seeing another dog meant lunging, pulling, and trying to start conflict. Through obedience work and carefully controlled sessions with Bishop, Ryder learned a valuable lesson: not every dog is a threat, and not every situation requires a reaction. Also notice how Bishop's corrections increase in intensity throughout the video. He starts with the minimum amount of pressure necessary and only escalates when Ryder chooses not to listen. That's how dogs naturally communicate with one another. Will I tell these owners to take her to a dog park and expect her to be everyone's best friend? Absolutely not. But can we give her a better quality of life by helping her calmly walk past another dog across the street? Absolutely. Not every dog needs this type of training, but some dogs can benefit tremendously from it. Another fun training day with my daughter, Lucy! Lucy woke up and asked if I could run her through a workout so of course we hit it.  As a 9 year old, we do a vast mix of training, but this training can be applied to any age (with modifications, of course): Cone game - lateral movement focus. This is a game the kids love and it’s a great warm up. Stand there and throw some cones back and forth while they try to “knock as many as they can” down. They don’t realize the reaction and lateral movement they are creating by simply playing a game!  Sandbag drags (or sled drag) is great for any age. Great from the ground up. If you suffer from knee pain, I highly suggest reverse sledding or reverse treadmill.  Dead hangs.  Amazing for grip strength, spinal decompression, shoulder mobility, back, core. Studies show grip strength is one of the strongest indicators of longevity.  Pushups. Lucy is killing it on the elevated pushups. This set she hit 13 with good form. We have moved her down every week and pretty soon she will be killing them from the floor.  Jumping. By far the best thing for children imo. Requires power and strength, coordination, and deceleration. Power is lost way before strength in adults. Somewhere along the lines adults stop jumping and creating true power and it’s a detriment to our capabilities.  Isometrics. Awesome for any age. Great for joint-angle specificity and muscle growth.  These workouts are not just for my 9 year old. Modifications can be made for any fitness level. Get out there and get after it today! Summer classes move quick, so you can’t wait until test week to find out what you remember. Stop relying on passive review and start using active recall. Pull the information from memory without your notes. Don’t just look over the material. Practice explaining it. And one of the easiest ways to do this is flashcards. But don’t just flip and recognize answers. Use them like cue cards. Ask why, what, and how. Make yourself answer before flipping, even if you’re struggling. Separate what you get right and wrong, and keep repeating the ones you miss. Then space it out: review one day later, then three days, then seven. In a summer class, consistency matters even more. 👩‍🏫내가 원하는 **‘추구미’**에 도달하려면  ✔️메이크업뿐만 아니라  ✔️헤어, 스타일링, 분위기까지 전체적인 합을 맞춰야 함 ✅원하는 대상의 스타일링 분석, 카피-> 미감 자체를 따라잡기 ⬇️영상 핵심 내용만 체크해보기 1. 메이크업만으로는 부족해! 전체적인 스타일링이 핵심  ‘얼굴이 다했다’는 생각은 금물: 뷰티 영상을 볼 때 무작정 화장법만 따라 하기보다는, 그 사람이 풍기는 전체적인 분위기와 스타일링 조합을 파악하는 게 중요해.  추구미 = 메이크업 + 헤어 + 패션 + 분위기: 내가 원하는 추구미에 맞춰 여러 요소를 종합적으로 바꿔야 메이크업도 훨씬 빛을 발하고 분위기가 완성돼! 2. 예시로 보는 추구미 분석 & 스타일링 팁 ✨ 1) 화려하고 독보적인 공주님 스타일 (ex. 장원영)  추구미 방향: "나는 특별하고 화려해 보이고 싶다!"  스타일링 포인트: 조금 더 진하고 또렷한 메이크업, 공들인 헤어 스타일링, 다이어트와 자기관리. 화려한 패션스타일(남들이 시도하지 않는) 🌿 2) 수수하고 깨끗한 청순 스타일 (ex. 정채연)  추구미 방향: "오밀조밀하고 수수하면서도 청순한 느낌을 내고 싶다!"  스타일링 포인트:  피부: 미백 앰플이나 톤업 크림을 활용해 맑고 하얀 피부 바탕 가꾸기.  헤어: 자연 흑갈색 톤 & 레이어드 컷으로 결을 살린 긴 생머리 연출.  아이 & 브로우: 눈썹 탈색 대신 결만 살리고, 눈은 점막만 채운 뒤 마스카라로 깔끔하게!  립 & 치크: 볼터치와 립을 강조해서 생기 더하기.  패션: 핀터레스트에 ‘청순 코디’를 검색해 마음에 드는 스타일을 찾은 뒤, 쇼핑앱(에이블리 등)에서 비슷한 옷을 매치해 보기! 3. 핵심 포인트 💖  분위기와 미감은 스스로 만드는 것:  스타일링과 분위기, 미감은 돈으로 살 수 없는 나만의 영역.  나를 가꾸는 기쁨 느끼기: 무작정 똑같이 따라 하기보다 나만의 추구미를 찾고, 화장을 통해 내 얼굴의 장점을 살리면서 나를 더 사랑하고 예쁘게 가꿔보기 💭Ps. 그 추구미를 “추구하는 이유가 뭐야?” 이 질문에서 자신의 결핍된 욕구와 니즈를 찾을 수 있고 그걸 채워가면서 만족하는게 자기관리야 -유리멘탈이 겉으로는 더 쎈 이미지를 가진 이유이기도 하달까?  이게 나쁜게 아니라, 그렇게 상호보완 하는게 자연스러운 법칙이거든 나 자신을 사랑하며 가꾸는 메이크업과 스타일링 화장 잘하는 언니 메이뮤와 오래 천천히 함께해💚
